answer.reason: The cave of Adullam is where David took refuge and gathered men, a defining event of the place, while the other verses merely list it.

clauses.english: was where David escaped to a cave and became captain of about four hundred men
clauses.quote: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam

doubts: GEN 38:1 concerns an Adullamite man (Hirah), and the verses in JOS 12, JOS 15, 2CH 11, NEH 11 and MIC 1 only list or name the town, so they were left out.
2SA 23:13-17 mentions three of David's mighty men coming to the cave, but the story that follows is about Bethlehem's well, so it was not made a clause.
